2. One MyST page, docs/usage/getting-started.md
3. One real blog post, 2026-05-18-v0-3-0-release-overview, at its current .html URL
4. One authored API contract page using the astro-site-02 template
5. One generated query docs page from scripts/generate_query_docs.py
6. Landing hero
7. Explorer at /results/ with working deep links (direct load of a nested /results/... route and of a query-string state URL)
8. Shared header and theme, using localStorage key benchbox:theme
9. Browser back/forward navigation, and DuckDB worker/WASM loading verified in Chromium
10. Pagefind over docs and blog

Measure on the same CI runner class:
- build time vs the current docs-build step
- HTML+JS bytes per page
- that docs and blog pages load zero Explorer/DuckDB bytes
- axe results
- exact URL output
